# Concordia University Library

> Academic library providing discovery tools, research resources, and comprehensive support services for Concordia University students and faculty.

Concordia University Library serves as the central hub for academic research at Concordia University, offering access to books, journals, databases, and specialized collections through the Sofia Discovery tool and Spectrum institutional repository. The library provides extensive instructional support, citation guidance, and research assistance to help students succeed in their academic work.

## Key Topics

- Sofia Discovery tool
- Spectrum Research Repository
- Library databases
- Course reserves
- Interlibrary loans
- Citation styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, Turabian)
- Special Collections & Archives
- Research guides
- AI literacy
- BrowZine
- Academic support
- Resource discovery
- Workshops and instruction
- Ask a Librarian service
- Concordia app

## Core Discovery & Resources

- [Concordia University Library](https://library.concordia.ca): Main library homepage with Sofia Discovery tool and academic resources
- [Find Resources](https://library.concordia.ca/find): How to find books, ebooks, articles, databases, videos and more resources
- [Databases](https://library.concordia.ca/find/databases): Browse and access academic databases and research resources by subject
- [Spectrum Research Repository](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca): Institutional repository for Concordia research, theses, and scholarly works
- [Special Collections and Archives](https://library.concordia.ca/find/special-collections): Special Collections and Archives resources and discovery tools

## Research & Writing Support

- [Help & How-to](https://library.concordia.ca/help): Subject guides, general guides, and library help resources for students
- [Citation Guides](https://library.concordia.ca/help/citing): Citation guides for APA, MLA, Turabian, Chicago, and other standards
- [Finding Resources](https://library.concordia.ca/help/finding): Guides for finding and evaluating journals, databases, and Sofia resources
- [Writing Support](https://library.concordia.ca/help/writing): Writing support and research tools guides for academic writing
- [AI Literacy](https://library.concordia.ca/help/ai/index.php): AI literacy guide and educational resources for students
- [Ask a Librarian](https://library.concordia.ca/help/questions): Ask a Librarian reference service for research and library assistance

## Borrowing & Access Services

- [Loans & Returns (Circulation)](https://library.concordia.ca/help/circulation): Guide to borrowing, renewing, and returning library items and procedures
- [Course Reserves](https://library.concordia.ca/help/reserves/reserves-login.php): Access course reserves and login for assigned course materials
- [Interlibrary Loans](https://library.concordia.ca/find/interlibrary-loans): Interlibrary loan service for accessing materials from other libraries
- [Intercampus Delivery](https://library.concordia.ca/find/intercampus): Guide to intercampus delivery of bound periodicals and microforms

## Learning & Instruction

- [Instructional Services](https://library.concordia.ca/help/instructional-services): Library instructional services and academic support offerings
- [Workshops](https://library.concordia.ca/help/workshops): Library workshop information, schedules, and registration details
- [Learn with the Library](https://library.concordia.ca/help/learn-with-the-library.php): Learning resources and student orientation for library services
- [General User Guides](https://library.concordia.ca/help/users): General user guides and quick links to library tools and services
